source_caption:
🎬 Everybody Hates Chris (2005–2009)

Everybody Hates Chris follows the hilarious and often frustrating childhood experiences of Chris, a teenager growing up in Brooklyn, New York, during the 1980s, inspired by the real-life experiences of comedian Chris Rock. Living in a working-class family in the Bedford-Stuyvesant neighborhood, Chris constantly struggles to navigate school, friendships, family responsibilities, and the everyday challenges of adolescence. His strict but loving mother Rochelle keeps the household under control with her outspoken personality, while his hardworking father Julius carefully watches every dollar and works multiple jobs to support the family. Meanwhile, Chris must deal with his mischievous younger brother Drew, his demanding little sister Tonya, and the endless problems that come with being the oldest child. Attending a predominantly white school far from his neighborhood, Chris frequently encounters bullying, embarrassing situations, unfair treatment, and hilarious misunderstandings while trying to fit in. From awkward romantic experiences and school disasters to ridiculous family arguments and unexpected life lessons, Chris discovers that growing up is rarely easy. Combining sharp comedy, nostalgic storytelling, unforgettable characters, and relatable family struggles, the series explores friendship, perseverance, family loyalty, identity, and the hilarious realities of teenage life.

🎭 Genre: Sitcom • Comedy • Family

⭐ IMDb: 7.6/10

⏱️ Runtime: 22 minutes per episode • TV-PG

🎥 Creators: Chris Rock & Ali LeRoi

source_details.synopsis: Everybody Hates Chris is an American semi-autobiographical sitcom created by Chris Rock and Ali LeRoi that originally aired on UPN from 2005 to 2006, and then on The CW until 2009. The series is based loosely on Rock's personal experiences as a teenager living in Bedford–Stuyvesant, Brooklyn, New York City from 1982 to 1987. However, Rock's real-life adolescence took place from 1978 to 1984, as he was born in 1965. The series' title is a parody of the CBS sitcom Everybody Loves Raymond. It was originally developed to air on Fox before being passed over to UPN. The series was shown on UPN for its first season until it was moved to the CW, where it aired its remaining three seasons.
